host.description: URL of your Mealie instance, e.g. https://mealie.yourdomain.com (required)

apiKey.description: Mealie API key (required unless username and password are set)

username.description: Mealie username or email (used when no apiKey is set)

password.description: Mealie password (used when no apiKey is set)

householdId.description: Household ID (UUID) of the meal plan; blank uses the default household

groupId.description: Group ID (UUID) of the meal plan; blank uses the default group

currentWeek.description: Only show meals for the current week

weekStartsOnMonday.description: Use Monday as the first day of the week (only with currentWeek)

dayLimit.description: Number of days to show after today

priorDayLimit.description: Number of previous days to show

entryLimit.description: Maximum number of entries from today and future days

priorEntryLimit.description: Maximum number of entries from previous days

template.description: Layout: default (list) or mealie (day columns grouped by meal type)

fontSize.description: Base font size of the module

fadePriorEntries.description: Fade previous days in the current week

defaultPicture.description: Picture for missing recipe images or meal notes: a URL, a path, or a file in the module folder

groupByDay.description: Group meals under a heading for each day (default template)

showDescription.description: Show the recipe description or meal note

showTodayLabel.description: Show "Today" instead of the day name for today's meals

dateFormat.description: Moment.js format for the date, e.g. ddd DD

dateMealSeperator.description: Text between the date and the meal type (default template)

mealSortOrder.description: Order and visibility of meal types

mealTypeName.description: Custom display names for meal types, e.g. { "side": "Meal Prep" }

updateInterval.description: How often to update the meal plan, in seconds

animationSpeed.description: Speed of the update animation, in milliseconds

displayLastUpdate.description: Show the last update time after the meals

displayLastUpdateFormat.description: Moment.js format for the last update time
